<sources>
<source id="FAQ-026" type="document">
How long does standard delivery take? (United Kingdom)

Standard delivery in the United Kingdom takes 2–4 business days after dispatch; express takes next business day.
</source>
<source id="POL-SHIPPING-UK" type="document">
Shipping policy (United Kingdom) > Delivery times

- **Standard:** 2–4 business days after dispatch.
- **Express:** next business day after dispatch.

Orders placed before noon local time on a business day are usually dispatched the same day.
The delivery date for your order is shown at checkout and in your order tracking.
</source>
<source id="FAQ-025" type="document">
How long do I have to return an item? (United Kingdom)

In the United Kingdom you can return unworn items within 28 days of delivery. See the returns policy for exceptions.
</source>
<source id="FAQ-017" type="document">
What if my item arrives damaged?

Contact customer care within 14 days of delivery with a photo and we will send a replacement or refund you.
</source>
<source id="POL-RETURNS-UK" type="document">
Returns policy (United Kingdom) > Your statutory rights

You have a 14-day right to cancel from delivery, in addition to our own return window. You do not need to give a reason.

Refunds are issued within 5 business days of the return reaching our warehouse.
</source>
</sources>
<question>How long does standard delivery take?</question>
<reference>2–4 business days.</reference>
<expected>answer the question from the sources</expected>
<answer>Standard delivery in the UK takes 2–4 business days after dispatch [FAQ-026][POL-SHIPPING-UK]. Orders placed before noon on a business day are usually dispatched the same day [POL-SHIPPING-UK]. If you'd like it faster, express delivery arrives the next business day after dispatch [POL-SHIPPING-UK].

The exact delivery date for your order is shown at checkout and in your order tracking [POL-SHIPPING-UK].</answer>

- declined: true if the answer says it cannot answer because the information is not available, instead of giving an answer. Asking a clarifying question is not declining.
